data.scope: Native allocator instrumented 600s/720p diagnostic; early clean baseline/full Chromium tree; not speed, uninstrumented memory or public certification

asBuiltManifest.libraryOptimizationScope: Existing final-link LTO only; libraries use Wasm objects
asBuiltManifest.forceIntraCall: Typed C++ virtual call with explicit all-layers argument -1; no function-cast emulation
asBuiltManifest.matroskaFinalization: Normal seekable duration/tag/segment finalization; per-keyframe cue collection disabled
asBuiltManifest.mp4Timing: Delay bounded initial fragment header for accurate edit lists; disable automatic negative timestamp shifting
asBuiltManifest.patentScope: Self-compiled Wasm is not a Cisco-distributed binary; no claim of Cisco royalty coverage or legal clearance.
